text:
anika: quick FYI — scheduling a staged reboot + nic microcode push for us-west2 racks r-20..r-25 tonight, window 23:30-01:30 UTC. goal is single-pass microcode + driver patch to address small packet drop under load.

anika: expected behavior: each rack cohort will be cordoned, drained (graceful 300s), reboot, run kv/prefix cache reseed, then uncordon. we expect short-lived evictions and a transient 3-8% capacity drop per cohort. overall rollout ~6 cohorts, 10m between cohort starts.

jorge: ack. what's the canary plan?

anika: canary = r-20 at 23:30 UTC. run 45s smoke (connectivity + 1k-token gen) + 2m stability. if OK, proceed. fallback: reimage to previous driver and reenter nodes.

mei: flag: two long-running eval jobs from infra-research hit us-west2 at 00:00 UTC. I'll ask them to pin to eu-west1 or pause.

jorge: ops note — avoid proxy-evac to reduce churn for long connections. set skip-proxy-evac=true and set drain-timeout=300s. after uncordon, run kv-seeder job: ```kubectl -n infra run kv-seeder --image=infra/kv-seeder:stable -- /seed --region=us-west2 --rack=r-20```

anika: adding cache warmup window of 2m after each cohort. also enabling auto-route-fallback for latency-critical traffic to compatible v2 models during cohort windows.

ops-bot: preflight checklist link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/usw2-microcode. Alerting thresholds: escalate if >4 pod restarts in 10m in same cohort.

deploy-bot: canary r-20 started at 23:30:12 UTC. smoke done (23:31:00) — metrics look nominal. proceeding to r-21 in 10m. logs: https://logs.internal/us-west2/r-20/canary/1719123456

mei: partner-scheduled inference at 00:05 UTC — emailed partner to move to 01:10 UTC.

jorge: cost note — backfill + burst nodes could add ~$320 to the incident window. propose we use spare reserved capacity first, then burst.

anika: approved. tag billing for chargeback. track spend on the maintenance PR.

mei: one more thing — ensure regional failover tests run post-rollout. I'll kick a small synthetic load to validate end-to-end latency and kv-hit-rate.

jorge: copied to maintenance doc and paging list. will monitor dashboards and post status in this thread every cohort. :eyes:

anika: thanks all. if anyone has pinned rollouts or embargoed jobs in us-west2, post here now. Otherwise we'll start preflight at 23:00 UTC.
